tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Show which identity FlowAgent is authenticated as: the active Azure CLI account, the Azure CLI profile directory (honours AZURE_CONFIG_DIR), the resolved cloud, the token cache location, and the tenant the token actually carries. Use this first when calls fail with EnvironmentAccessDenied, ServiceToServiceEnvironmentNotFound, or an ENOTFOUND on *.environment.api.powerplatform.com.

tools.name: reconnect
tools.description: Clear FlowAgent's cached tokens and re-acquire as the account the Azure CLI is currently signed in as. Use after `az login`/`az account set` switched accounts, or when a stale token is causing 401/403 failures — this avoids restarting the session.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Run FlowAgent's auth and connectivity checklist: Azure CLI present, az signed in, AZURE_CONFIG_DIR scoping, resolved cloud, token acquisition, token-vs-az identity agreement, current environment, and environment reachability. Returns per-check pass/warn/fail with a concrete fix for anything that isn't passing.

tools.name: list_environments
tools.description: List all Power Automate environments. Use query to filter by name.

tools.name: resolve_environment
tools.description: Check which environment the current user resolves to via environment routing

env.description: Environment ID or omit for default

tools.name: get_current_env
tools.description: Show the current working environment that env-less tool calls (and the dashboard) target. Source is one of: env-var, set_tool, auto-remember, dashboard, none.

tools.name: set_current_env
tools.description: Set the current working environment that env-less tool calls (and the dashboard) target. Pass an env GUID OR a display-name substring; the latter is resolved against list_environments. Validates the env exists before saving.

env.description: Environment ID (GUID) or a unique display-name substring

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List cloud flows. Supports name search.

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Get a flow's full definition + connection refs + metadata. Use this when you need to inspect or modify a specific flow. For large flows, use `path` to scope the response (e.g. path: "definition.actions.MyAction" or path: "properties.connectionReferences"). For metadata across many flows, prefer list_flows (4× faster — doesn't fetch the full definition per row).

path.description: Dot-separated path to extract a sub-section of the response (e.g. "definition.actions", "properties.connectionReferences"). Omit for the full flow.

tools.name: get_flow_context
tools.description: Resolve a flow's solution-membership: workflowId (Dataverse), workflowIdUnique (pre-publish), inSolution, solutionUniqueName, isManaged, isCustomizable, ownerId, category, and connectionReferenceLogicalNames. Use this BEFORE mutating a flow: refuse changes if isManaged=true, route name/description/owner changes through Dataverse for solution flows. `warning` is non-null if the lookup couldn't complete (no-dataverse-instance / workflow-not-found / dataverse-error) — treat that as 'no solution context, fall through to PPAPI behavior'.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.description: Create a new cloud flow from a JSON definition. **Auto-injects** $authentication + $connections parameters if missing (most agent-built definitions forget these — wave 8 fix). Refuses by default if a flow with the same displayName already exists (returns the existing flow ID + a hint to use update_flow). Pass allowDuplicate: true only when you really want a second flow with the same name. **Best practice**: call preflight_flow first to catch missing connection refs + solution-wrap risk before creating. **Use this for**: standing up a brand-new flow. **Do NOT use for**: editing an existing flow — use update_flow instead.

allowDuplicate.description: Bypass the no-duplicate-name guard. Default false.

tools.name: update_flow
tools.description: Update an existing flow's definition or properties. **Refuses by default if the flow lives in a managed Dataverse solution** (returns ManagedSolutionReadOnly). Pass forceManaged: true only if you understand the change will be overwritten on the next solution import — see docs/recipes/upgrade-managed-flow.md for the right pattern. **Recommended two-phase update**: call preview_update first to obtain a previewToken bound to the exact change, then pass that token back here. update_flow will only apply if the proposal still matches what was previewed (prevents lost writes from concurrent edits). Auto-captures a backup snapshot before applying (last 10 retained per flow, accessible via list_backups). **Use this for**: any change to an existing flow. **Do NOT use for**: creating a new flow (use create_flow) or starting/stopping a flow (use publish_flow / disable_flow).

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.

autoResolveConnectionRefs.description: Auto-resolve missing connection refs for new connectors in the definition. Default true. Set false to skip if auto-merge is causing errors.

previewToken.description: Token issued by preview_update for this exact (env, flow, body) tuple. When supplied, the update only applies if the proposed change still matches what was previewed; mismatched tokens throw PreviewTokenMismatch.

tools.name: preview_update
tools.description: Read-only: compute a diff between the live flow and the proposed update body, and return a short-lived single-use token. Use the token with update_flow to apply the change only if the proposal still matches what you reviewed. No mutation is performed by this tool.

tools.name: edit_flow
tools.description:
Apply targeted ('surgical') edits to an existing flow's definition without resending the whole thing — ideal for changing one action, parameter, or expression on a large flow. Each operation has an `op` and a slash-delimited `path` into the definition (e.g. `actions/Send_Email/inputs/parameters/subject`):
  • set — set (create or overwrite) the value at path
  • add — insert a new key at path (fails if it already exists)
  • remove — delete the key at path
  • merge — deep-merge an object value into the existing object at path (sibling keys preserved)
Routes through the same safety path as update_flow: auto-backup, managed-solution guard (pass forceManaged to override), and optional preview token. Works on non-solution and unmanaged-solution flows, with or without connection references. Set dryRun: true to get a diff + single-use previewToken without writing; re-call with the SAME operations plus that previewToken to apply. **Use this for**: small, precise changes to an existing flow. **Use update_flow** when replacing the whole definition.

path.description: Slash-delimited path into the definition, e.g. actions/Compose/inputs

value.description: New value (required for set/add/merge; merge requires an object)

dryRun.description: If true, return a diff + previewToken without writing.

previewToken.description: Token from a prior dryRun for these exact operations; applies only if the flow still matches.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.

autoResolveConnectionRefs.description: Auto-resolve missing connection refs for new connectors in the definition. Default true.

tools.name: copy_flow
tools.description: Copy a flow within the same environment or to another environment. Reads the source definition and re-creates it as a new, standalone flow (created Stopped by default). Same-env copies reuse the source connection references verbatim. Cross-env copies re-resolve each connector in the target environment (Dataverse-first, PPAPI fallback); connectors with no usable connection there are returned in `unresolvedConnectors` and the flow is left Stopped so it can't run half-wired. Flows with no connection references (built-in actions only) copy cleanly. Solution-bound sources (managed or unmanaged) are copied as plain standalone flows — solution membership is dropped (noted in the response). **Use this for**: duplicating a flow or promoting it across environments. **Do NOT use for**: a true managed-solution clone — use solution export/import.

targetEnv.description: Target environment ID (defaults to source env = same-env duplicate)

state.description: Initial state of the copy (default Stopped)

autoResolveConnections.description: For cross-env copies, auto-resolve connections in the target. Default true.

tools.name: publish_flow
tools.description: Enable (start) a flow. Refuses by default for managed-solution flows; pass forceManaged: true to override.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.

tools.name: disable_flow
tools.description: Disable (stop) a flow. Refuses by default for managed-solution flows; pass forceManaged: true to override.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.

tools.name: delete_flow
tools.description: Permanently delete a flow. **Refuses by default for managed-solution flows** (deletion is irreversible AND will be undone on next solution import). Pass forceManaged: true to override. **Use this when**: the flow is no longer needed AND you've confirmed no other flow / connection / app depends on it. **Do NOT use when**: you just want to stop the flow temporarily — use disable_flow (reversible). Auto-captures a backup snapshot before deletion, accessible via restore_backup for ~10 retentions.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.

tools.name: run_flow
tools.description: Trigger a manual flow run. Set wait=true to poll until completion. Uses the authenticated management path for Power Apps / Power Apps V2 (Direct-API) triggers, which reject unauthenticated calls. Request-family triggers keep using the SAS callback URL when a body is supplied so triggerBody() is populated. Set useCallbackUrl explicitly to override.

body.description: Trigger body JSON. For Power Apps V2 triggers, pass the schema parameters as top-level keys.

triggerName.description: Trigger to invoke. Defaults to the flow's first trigger.

useCallbackUrl.description: Force (true) or forbid (false) the unauthenticated SAS callback path. Ignored for Power Apps / Power Apps V2 triggers.

tools.name: get_run_history
tools.description: Get recent run history for a flow

tools.name: get_run_details
tools.description: Get details for a specific flow run

tools.name: get_run_actions
tools.description: Get action-level execution details for a specific flow run

tools.name: get_run_action_repetitions
tools.description: List iteration-level details for an action that runs inside a loop (Apply_to_each / Do_until) within a run — the only way to see WHICH iteration failed. Each repetition has its own status, inputs/outputs links, and (on failure) error. Pass the name of an action **inside** the loop (e.g. a Compose within the Apply_to_each), NOT the loop container itself — the container action returns no repetitions. `flow` defaults to the pinned current flow (set_current_flow).

flow.description: Flow ID (defaults to pinned current flow)

tools.name: cancel_run
tools.description: Cancel a single in-progress (Running/Waiting) flow run. `flow` defaults to the pinned current flow.

flow.description: Flow ID (defaults to pinned current flow)

tools.name: resubmit_run
tools.description: Resubmit a past run using its original trigger inputs (the trigger is auto-detected from the run). Useful after fixing the cause of a failure. `flow` defaults to the pinned current flow.

flow.description: Flow ID (defaults to pinned current flow)

trigger.description: Trigger name (auto-detected from the run if omitted)

tools.name: cancel_all_runs
tools.description: Bulk-cancel every in-progress run of a flow — for incident response when many erroneous runs are queued. Uses the Dataverse CancelAllCloudFlowRuns bulk action when the flow has a Dataverse workflow record (solution AND modern non-solution flows); otherwise cancels each Running/Waiting run individually. Optionally turns the flow off afterwards (turnOff) so the root cause can be fixed. Statuses transition Running/Waiting → Canceling → Canceled (can take up to 24h). `flow` defaults to the pinned current flow.

flow.description: Flow ID (defaults to pinned current flow)

turnOff.description: Also disable the flow after cancelling. Default false.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution guard when turning the flow off. Default false.

tools.name: diagnose_run
tools.description: Diagnose a flow run: classify each failed/timed-out action with an actionable remediation. Read-only — fetches run details + actions and maps known error codes (auth, throttling, 404, dependent-action, etc.) to fixes. `flow` defaults to the pinned current flow.

flow.description: Flow ID (defaults to pinned current flow)

tools.name: get_expression_help
tools.description: Look up Power Automate (Logic Apps WDL) expression functions — name, signature, description, and a copy-pasteable example. Filter by `query` (matches name/signature/description) and/or `category`. No args returns the full curated reference.

tools.name: set_current_flow
tools.description: Pin a flow as the session's current flow. Once pinned, run/debug tools (cancel_run, resubmit_run, cancel_all_runs, get_run_action_repetitions, diagnose_run) use it when `flow` is omitted — a guardrail so an autonomous agent acts on exactly one flow.

tools.name: get_current_flow
tools.description: Get the session's pinned current flow (or null if none).

tools.name: clear_current_flow
tools.description: Unpin the session's current flow.

tools.name: get_past_trigger_inputs
tools.description: Fetch trigger input envelopes from past flow runs — same primitive the PA designer uses for 'Test with previous run data'. Returns most-recent first by default. Use --top to limit, --runId for a specific run, --statusFilter to filter Succeeded/Failed. Each entry includes triggerInputs + a contentDigest for deduping. Best companion to test_run for instant testing without manual scaffolding.

runId.description: Fetch a specific run instead of latest

tools.name: preflight_flow
tools.description: Pre-save sanity check: validate the definition + check connection-ref status + detect solution-wrap-will-block-publish risk. Use BEFORE create_flow or update_flow to catch the common failure modes (missing $authentication, broken connection ref, CannotStartUnpublishedSolutionFlow). Returns {overall: ready|warn|block, validation, connectionRefs, solutionWrap, summary[]}.

connectionReferences.description: Connection refs in flow body (same shape as create_flow)

tools.name: list_trigger_emulators
tools.description: List the trigger types FlowAgent can emulate via direct connector calls (SharePoint NewItem → CreateItem etc.). Use this to know whether emulate_live_trigger (P1, pending) can fire a real trigger event for a given flow without waiting for an organic external event. Returns array of {triggerOperation, connector, emulatorOperation, livenessImpact, defaultPayload, notes?}.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List connections in an environment, optionally filtered by connector. Returns summarized fields (name, connector, displayName, status, owner, accountName, createdTime).

tools.name: resolve_refs
tools.description: Auto-discover connections for connectors and output connection references JSON. Tries Dataverse first, falls back to PPAPI lookup.

tools.name: pick_or_create_connection
tools.description: Idempotent: get a Connected connectionName for the requested connector. Discovers via Dataverse→PPAPI fallback; if none found, creates one (uses silent first-party auth for M365 connectors, browser consent otherwise). Use this instead of stitching list_connections + resolve_refs + create_connection by hand. Returns {mode: found|created|found-not-connected|no-connection-and-create-disabled, connectionName, status, authMode, connector, refSourcePath}.

noBrowser.description: Don't open browser on consent (print URL instead)

params.description: Connection parameters (e.g. for SQL: server, database)

tools.name: resolve_params
tools.description: Designer-emulating dropdown resolver: returns every parameter for a connector operation with its dynamic values (lists, trees, dynamic-schemas) already resolved. Replaces N round-trips of get_dynamic_list/tree/schema with one. Auto-discovers a connection if none passed (Dataverse→PPAPI fallback — handles Dataverse-only orgs). Per-dropdown errors are returned per-parameter; the call never fails wholesale. Schema is cached per session for 5 min. Use before create_flow when you don't yet know the dropdown values to pass.

connection.description: Connection name; if omitted, auto-discovered via Dataverse→PPAPI

currentInputs.description: Concrete values for parent params (e.g. siteUrl, listId) so child dropdowns can resolve

tools.name: resolve_entity
tools.description: Resolve display names to IDs for dynamic connector parameters (folders, teams, channels, lists, tables). Uses the connector's own picker APIs via API Hub — works where resolve_params fails (Outlook folders, Teams locations). Pass the connector, entity type, display name query, and optionally dependencies (e.g. team name for channel resolution). Returns: resolved ID + confidence (exact/fuzzy/ambiguous/not-found) + alternatives when ambiguous. **Fail-closed**: ambiguous results should be confirmed with the user before using in a flow definition.

entityType.description: Parameter/entity type to resolve (e.g. folderPath, groupId, channelId, entityName, table, form_id, planId, bucketId)

query.description: Display name to search for (e.g. 'Inbox', 'Power Automate', 'General')

dependencies.description: Parent parameter values needed for cascading resolution (e.g. {groupId: '<teamId>'} for channel lookup)

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Check whether a specific connection is currently Connected. Use to verify a connection is still authenticated before relying on it (cheaper than running the flow and getting a runtime auth error).

tools.name: fix_connection
tools.description: Re-authenticate a broken connection (e.g. expired token). For first-party M365 connectors this is silent; for OAuth connectors a browser opens for consent. Use when test_connection returns connected=false or when a flow run fails with auth errors.

noBrowser.description: Don't open browser; print consent URL instead

tools.name: delete_connection
tools.description: Delete a connection. Requires confirm:true to actually delete (prevents accidental destruction). Note: deleting a connection used by an enabled flow will break that flow at next run; check `list_flows` for dependencies first.

confirm.description: Must be true to perform the delete. Prevents accidental destruction.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List available connectors. Use query to filter by name. Returns name + displayName + tier.

tools.name: get_connector
tools.description: Get connector operation index. Use query to filter. Use get_operation_details for full param specs.

tools.name: search_operations
tools.description: Search connector operations by keyword. Returns operation name, description, connector, and type.

tools.name: get_operation_details
tools.description: Get exact param names, types, enums, and required action type for a connector operation

tools.name: invoke_operation
tools.description: Call a connector's dynamic resolver (dropdowns, tree browsing, dynamic schemas)

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: List available datasets for a tabular connector (SharePoint sites, SQL servers, Excel locations, etc.). Use before list_tables to discover what datasets/sites/servers are available. Calls the connector's GetDataSets operation via API Hub.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables/lists in a dataset for a tabular connector (SharePoint lists, SQL tables, Excel tables, etc.). Requires a dataset name from list_datasets (e.g. a SharePoint site URL, a SQL server+db string). Calls the connector's GetTables operation via API Hub.

dataset.description: Dataset name from list_datasets (e.g. SharePoint site URL, SQL server string)

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List built-in flow templates

tools.name: scaffold_flow
tools.description: Generate flow definition from template. Pass env to auto-resolve connections. When env is provided, connection resolution is REQUIRED — returns an error with missing connectors if any can't be resolved. Without env, returns placeholder refs for offline use.

tools.name: validate_flow
tools.description: Pre-validate a flow definition against PA rules

tools.name: smoke_test
tools.description: End-to-end connectivity test: create, run, verify, cleanup

tools.name: list_desktop_flows
tools.description: List desktop flows (RPA) in an environment

tools.name: run_desktop_flow
tools.description: Trigger a desktop flow and wait for completion

tools.name: list_machine_groups
tools.description: List machine groups in an environment

tools.name: list_backups
tools.description: List pre-mutation backup snapshots captured for a flow. Newest first. Last 10 retained per flow.

tools.name: get_backup
tools.description: Read a specific backup snapshot's full contents (flow definition, connectionReferences, optional context).

tools.name: restore_backup
tools.description: Restore a flow from a backup snapshot. If the flow still exists, the current state is itself backed up and then the flow is updated in place. If the flow was deleted, it is recreated (which yields a new flow ID). Pass file to choose a specific backup; omit for the latest.

file.description: Backup filename. Defaults to most recent.

forceManaged.description: Override the managed-solution read-only guard. Default false.
